title: Flying lucidly
content: I can fly lucidly in my dreams from time to time.. and I don’t really like it. Maybe that’s an unpopular opinion but I’ll explain why…. Many times I find myself viewing things from a Birds Eye view- I’m ok with this and find it quite interesting. However, there’s times where I have trouble controlling my speed and I get really nervous that I’m straying too far from home / my safe space. I fear I’ll have trouble finding my way back. Sometimes I find myself looking at a 3D world map- almost like being inside google earth, floating in the area. But the map is always very plain and flat… just blue denoting bodies of water and tan for land. I can make out all of the continents/countries by shape. I have the feeling that I can select wherever I want to go but for some reason there’s always a “pull” taking me to the Indian Ocean region. Very strange bc I’ve never traveled there and I’m not too familiar with that area besides basic geography knowledge and relevant news stories. I don’t like being over there. I just get an overwhelming feeling of loneliness and isolation. Hovering over the ocean while flying lucidly freaks me out. It’s cool for a second, because I feel free like a bird.. until I’m fully surrounded by the vastness of the water and immediately terrified. Side note: speaking of google earth, I use the app occasionally but find myself 9/10 times getting freaked out and closing out of it. IDK WHY. again, maybe the vastness of everything is too overwhelming? So anyway, that uncomfortable anxious feeling is the same when I’m flying in my dreams. Sometimes when I dream about the childhood cul-de-sac I grew up in, I have the ability to fly there too. It’s always very late at night and the sky is lit up with purple and blue stars. This is sometimes enjoyable but I’m careful to keep a safe distance; if I hover too high I may get sucked into space. Or atleast it feels that way. With these feelings, why do I even fly when given the ability to? Why chance ruining a fun dream? No clue. I guess maybe I forget about my previous experiences for a split second and take full advantage of the opportunity. Only to regret it (sometimes) haha
